scope: factory-to-installation delivery, partial handover, material and subcontract acceptance, supplier billing, warranty correction and operational authorization
checks: Declined unaccepted replacement restores original released scope through the commercial API
Concurrent identical create requests return one batch
Payload mismatch and duplicate active task allocation rejected
Persisted quantities, candidate exclusion and project-scoped projection
Source changes flag review while the batch snapshot stays frozen
Versioned cancellation is replay safe and preserves historical allocation
Booked factory work, independent measured output, lot rework and passed finished stock persist through the API
Passed lot dispatch, independent site receipt, installation output and independent installation QC remain linked
Signed partial handover preserves inspected quantity and frozen closeout documents; duplicate acceptance is blocked and remaining work stays open
Partial receiving excludes quarantine and rejection from stock/billing, requires independent QC, blocks overbilling/overpayment and premature order closure

Subcontract service acceptance requires inspected task output, blocks early and duplicate certification across orders, and persists independent certification through invoice, full payment and order closure
Warranty correction stays linked to accepted work, rejects uncovered tasks and requires independent verification without rewriting handover
Global operational work reflects persisted source states, filters completed work and enforces workspace access
Database RLS hides batch, allocation and replay records from another workspace
